```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'resolved-entity'> ">
  %pe;
  <?processing-instruction target="compiler" data="optimize=true"?>
  <!-- DTD-level comment explaining the catalog schema -->
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
  <!-- Main catalog entry containing CDATA and entity references -->
  <item id="i1">
    <![CDATA[
      <nested-tag>&ent;</nested-tag>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item id="i2">&ent;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY ext "&base; Extended">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
  <?xml-meta author="tester" version="1.0"?>
  <!-- Internal DTD subset comment block -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://xml.org/root" xmlns:custom="http://xml.org/custom" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <?custom-pi action="init"?>
  <custom:node xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <!-- Comment right before CDATA section -->
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing unparsed entities or markup: &ext;
    ]]>
  </custom:node>
  <node>&ext;</node>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <!ENTITY delta "γ Delta">
  <!-- Complex entity chain declaration comment -->
  <?target-pi data="value"?>
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY report SYSTEM "report.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://xml.org/archive/meta">
  <meta:header>
    <?meta-pi load="true"?>
    <!-- Metadata comment -->
    <![CDATA[
      Archive metadata CDATA block.
    ]]>
  </meta:header>
  <record>δ</record>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE workspace [
  <!ELEMENT workspace (project*)>
  <!ELEMENT project (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY val "WorkspaceValue">
  <!ENTITY ref "&val; Reference">
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY blob SYSTEM "data.bin" NDATA bin>
  <?workspace-pi config="debug"?>
  <!-- Workspace DTD comment -->
]>
<workspace xmlns="http://xml.org/workspace" xmlns:ws="http://xml.org/workspace/ns">
  <!-- Outer wrapper comment -->
  <ws:project id="p1">
    <?ws-action execute="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Workspace CDATA payload with entities: &ref;
    ]]>
  </ws:project>
  <project id="p2">&ref;</project>
</workspace>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department*)>
  <!ELEMENT department (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY corp "Corporation">
  <!ENTITY subsidiary "&corp; Subsidiary">
  <!NOTATION zip SYSTEM "application/zip">
  <!ENTITY bundle SYSTEM "archive.zip" NDATA zip>
  <?enterprise-pi status="active"?>
  <!-- Enterprise DTD structural comment -->
]>
<enterprise xmlns="http://xml.org/enterprise" xmlns:hr="http://xml.org/enterprise/hr" xmlns:fin="http://xml.org/enterprise/fin">
  <!-- Human Resources section comment -->
  <hr:department code="HR01">
    <?hr-pi audit="pending"?>
    <![CDATA[
      HR CDATA block: &subsidiary;
    ]]>
  </hr:department>
  <fin:department code="FIN01">&subsidiary;</fin:department>
</enterprise>
```
